facts.fact: 父亲 NYE 派对（五十人、Catan）；她的车报废——借父亲的车。
facts.anchor: Unfortunately, nothing can save my car.

facts.fact: 在父亲面前不让他碰的「害羞」引爆Sean——他失望离席。
facts.anchor: In front of my dad—yeah, kinda.

facts.fact: 父亲劝解：新生活要慢慢抓 grip，heal 需要时间；Sean 是好人，去把话说开。
火堆对峙：他控诉——你只让我拥有了一夜，现在又不让我碰你。
facts.anchor: For one night. You let me have you for one night

facts.fact: 他摊牌：不想再按她的方式来——这一生就一次，给我想要的。
facts.anchor: just give me what I want.

facts.fact: Graham 回声（You’re too emotional）：跟 Sean 时感情太少，婚后又太多——现在不知自己是谁。
facts.anchor: Everything inside me flipped—when I used to be with Sean, I didn’t have enough feelings.

facts.fact: 他喊出十年：我爱上你超过十年了！该你说了——你从来没说出口过。
facts.anchor: For crying out loud, for over ten years

facts.fact: 她终于说出那句话——For once, the words feel nothing but true.
他答「谢谢」、额头相抵——不煽情的收据。
facts.anchor: “Thank you,” he says, clutching my head, placing our foreheads together.

facts.fact: 午夜倒计时之吻；父亲举杯致意——第一次默认。
facts.anchor: my dad is smiling at us with a glass in his hand, raising it to me.
